content.title: Chapter 66 - PARKS AND RECREATION — Sec. 66-25. - Snow and ice activities.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful to sled, ski, snowboard, ice skate, or snowshoe on any golf course
               or where such activity is prohibited by sign.
(Code 1960, § 17-31; Code 1981, § 22-6; Ord. No. 4112, § 1, 2, 5-5-2008)
